references.text: This passage lists the cities given to the tribe of Judah, including many of the same cities later given to Simeon from Judah's inheritance.
The immediate context describes Simeon's inheritance and how it was taken from Judah's portion because Judah's portion was too large.
Ramat-Negev is mentioned as a place in the Negev region, which is associated with Simeon's territory.
Baalat-Beer is identified with Ramat-Negev and is mentioned in connection with David sending spoils to the elders of the cities in Judah and Simeon.
First Chronicles repeats the list of Simeon's cities and villages, including Baal, which corresponds to Baalat-Beer.
Jacob's prophecy concerning Simeon and Levi explains why Simeon was scattered in Israel and received his inheritance within Judah's territory.
